title: Reusable, low-touch migration pipeline: scan, pack, run, compare, report
subtitle: Use case walkthrough. Numbers from tools/golden_path.py (pipeline stage on example-system/firmware-repo/)
footer: Standard-library Python; dry run by default; no agent ran during the golden path.

slides.title: Why 'convert this entire repo' fails
bullets: The whole tree is handed to the agent on every step: context and tokens run out
Nothing is left behind for a second engineer, a second program, or a CI job
'Done' is a sentence in a transcript, not a file with evidence
Needed: a pipeline the team owns in its repository, bounded per unit, resumable, honest about proof

slides.title: Five stages, one command
rows: runs the scanner for --lang c | matlab | labview
scan/: inventory, summary, repo map, dependency map, backlog
one bounded Markdown pack per unit, leaf-first
runs --agent-cmd per pack; dry run when absent
--compare-cmd, or checks the evidence files exist
proven / evidence present / unproven / failed / blocked / no result

slides.title: Controlling context and tokens
bullets: Scan once; every later step reads dependency-map.json and one pack, never the tree
One pack per unit with a budget: source, dependency excerpts, callers, open questions, result contract
Over budget: dependency excerpts shrink first, then source is truncated, and the pack says so
Leaf-first order: callers' packs point at finished work instead of carrying it
manifest.json shows bytes and tokens per pack before anything runs; choose --limit from it
Results persist in results/<id>/; the next unit reads files, not a transcript
Resume, do not restart: unchanged stages are skipped, done / blocked results survive

slides.title: Approaches compared
rows: only as good as the scanner; static
shows house style and the proof pattern
drifts; one example rarely covers an estate
another runtime to own; still needs a model per node
slides.note: Use all four: files as contract, a reference pair for style, skills for the per-unit procedure, the runner for control.

slides.title: What Devin adds, and where the offline path stops
left: AGENTS.md and skills read automatically per repository
CLI in the IDE against the working tree; Plan mode and least-privilege defaults
The same skill runs on the next program without re-explaining the method
Discovery, packing, compare, and report are plain Python: no agent required to run them
right: Agent execution needs the Cognition backend; unattended runs need a runner with that access
The golden path is a dry run: it proves the glue and the journal, not a migration
'done' is a claim; 'proven' needs a comparison or the evidence files
No tool ever moves a backlog item to closed

slides.title: In CI
bullets: .github/workflows/migration-scan.yml: manual (lang, tree, name inputs) or weekly
Runs scan -> pack -> report on the tree you name; uploads the pipeline folder as an artifact
Add --agent-cmd only where the runner has the agent available; otherwise it stays a dry run
check.yml already runs check_repo.py and golden_path.py on every push

slides.text: Bounded packs, files as the contract, a journal you can resume, and evidence before 'done'. The team owns the pipeline; the agent does one unit at a time.
